-- hey-cli: 1ac3ef0d9118de449d21cf52a46da419bbee6e02 -> 8976f638abd88217317d7862bfcf3642666fb38f (0-unstable-2026-09-10 -> 0-unstable-2026-09-13)
  could not resolve vendorHash from build error for hey-cli

escalation.verdict: Bumped overlays/94-hey-cli.nix to rev 8976f638abd88217317d7862bfcf3642666fb38f (0-unstable-2026-09-12), re-prefetched the src hash (sha256-arF5gxXXU9wQ7o4dQZ3+4sj6tSLPi2BGMUOmFAS7fZ0=), and updated overlays/updates.json's current_version/current_rev to match. Blanking vendorHash and building failed with 'go: go.mod requires go >= 1.27.0 (running go 1.26.7; GOTOOLCHAIN=local)'. This is NOT the known false-negative scenario documented in the skill (where the scoped build sees nixpkgs' unpinned default go while the repo's real go pin is sufficient) -- I confirmed the failure reproduces identically against the full system build (`.#darwinConfigurations.garmonbozia.pkgs.hey-cli`), which uses this repo's actual go pin from overlays/55-go.nix (currently 1.26.7). Upstream hey-cli's go.mod now genuinely requires a newer Go than this repo provides anywhere. A real fix requires bumping overlays/55-go.nix to Go >= 1.27, which is a separate package/overlay and out of scope for a hey-cli-only repair (touching it would affect every buildGoModule derivation in the repo). A human should decide whether to bump the go overlay to 1.27.x (verifying it doesn't break other Go packages) or leave hey-cli quarantined at 0-unstable-2026-09-10 until nixpkgs' default go catches up.
